_conforms_to.spec: O-RAN.WG6.O2IMS-Interface (provisioning intent shape) and TMF921 Intent Management API (intent envelope)
_conforms_to.spec_section: O2 IMS Provisioning, ProvisioningRequest resource; TMF921 Intent resource
_conforms_to.schema_role: Validates the Router output before the Guardrail engine evaluates it.

title: RemediationProposal
description: Structured proposal emitted by the Remediation Router. Carries the classification decision, the action payload reference, and the guardrail evaluation outcome.

targetLayer.description: Output of the routing rule. Infra routes DOWN via O2 IMS; service routes UP via TMF921; ambiguous returns to LLM-assist.

taxonomyMatch.description: Must match a taxonomy id from harness/taxonomy.yaml.

actionTarget.description: Node FQDN or cluster identifier the action applies to.

actionPayloadRef.description: Name of the MachineConfig, Module, or intent resource the action will deliver.

dryRun.description: True until the operator explicitly promotes per the co_authorization contract in guardrails.yaml.

sandbox_verdict.description: Harness-unique extension attached by walker.py sandbox_simulation(). Carries simulator_version, twin_converged, baseline_match, deviation_observed, apply_allowed, simulator_run_at, rationale. The guardrail engine gates the apply on apply_allowed.

companion_intent.description: Harness-unique extension attached by router.py _maybe_build_companion_intent() for dual-route node_firmware actions. Carries a TMF921 envelope plus an optional dispatch_result subfield recording the partner SMO's response.

o2ims_dispatch.description: Harness-unique extension attached by router.py _call_o2ims_deploy() when targetLayer=infra. Carries the O-Cloud Manager's DeploymentRequest response per O-RAN.WG6 O2 IMS Interface Specification (refs 2, 3, 6). Fields: accepted, deploymentManagerId, deploymentRequestId, ocloud_internal_path, reconciler_target, ocm_version, ocm_response, optional request_received_at. Absent on service-layer routes (those cross TMF921 instead).

reversibility_profile.description: Optional in v0. When present, conforms to harness/schemas/ReversibilityProfile.json.
